benchmark.scope: Homebrew elapsed time, not game performance

fixes: Fresh bounded blocks stop after memory writes; guest code remains unchanged.
Copied-instruction faults and asynchronous signal returns restore original guest PCs.
Native pthread_kill pauses tracing because its signal masking cannot run with TF set.
limits: Experimental and off by default; still too slow for normal gameplay.
Branches, RIP-relative instructions, x87 instructions and host calls retain single-stepping.
No persistent block cache; concurrent unsynchronized code or permission changes are not supported.
Guest cancellation, unusual signal-mask changes, guest debugging and every possible native-to-guest callback are not validated.
Jaguar in-use tracking, unsupported host state, generated CPU-ID handling and cross-platform runtime work remain outside this change.
